artboards.title: Component Spec — 26 components x 8 states per UI-UX 197-198

annotations.text: Prompt 48 — Full component spec. 26 components: Button, IconButton, TextField, SearchField, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Card, MetricCard, ListItem, Avatar, Badge, Chip, Tabs, BottomSheet, Modal/Dialog, Toast, Banner, Progress, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Chart, Table, DocumentPreview. All states: Default/Pressed/Focused/Disabled/Loading/Error/Selected/Success.
